source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_caa_integration.py tests/test_caa_evaluation.py tests/test_brain_context.py tests/test_brain_sync.py

claims.claim: The planning record identifies TASK-417 r1 and the ten-task pilot as the sole prospective NEXT, preserves historical PTE/CAA/Auto-NEXT records, and leaves CAA-05 unselected.

The supported consult_advisory caller reaches existing CAA-03 consultation for authenticated eligible subjects in all four Brain flows. It defaults disabled, preserves opt-out, and returns scoped unavailability when activation sources or trusted provider inputs are absent. No live production-provider activation is asserted.
Optional provider, profile, charge-authorization and unsafe-response failures remain bounded advisory outcomes; canonical subject, candidate and currentness errors retain fail-closed handling.

Cohort selection retains the first ten distinct new canonical TASK identities after authenticated publication in first-authoring order, excluding TASK-417 and counting revisions, corrections and repeated RUNs under their original identity.

The repair projects authenticated cut tuples as JSON arrays at activation, receipt and report boundaries. Sealed cut integrity, strict provider validation, source currentness, privacy bounds and temporal UNKNOWN handling remain intact; receipts are not retrospectively enriched.

The finite read-only report retains UNKNOWN quality and causal uplift, zero decisive samples and a Human/Brain handoff. CAA-04 independent preregistration, labels, provider/charge authorization and population/time limits remain separate requirements; the pilot does not select CAA-05.

The committed correction changes only cut projections in two source files, preserving existing authority boundaries and TASK-408 auditing policy without adding routing, persistence, training or lifecycle operations.

Existing production-shaped regressions cover controlled consultation, privacy, cohort limits, source/currentness and secondary effects. Ten selected implementation-local cases passed their assertions, but the command exited 1 on worker-observer consistency. No canonical verification success, full-suite result or rollout-efficiency claim is asserted.
